text:
Liam: Heads-up team: we need to finalize MVP trim decisions today. Proposal: defer Tenant Admin and Advanced Reporting to v1. Keep SSO, onboarding, prompt-store, and a minimal search UI in MVP. Agree/disagree?

Anita: Agree with deferring reporting. Concern: pilot customers expect an admin surface. Could we ship a lightweight "account counts" tile instead of full admin?

Sanjay: From infra: full embcache is high effort and increases combing complexity. Options: 1) no cache (simpler, worse tail), 2) prefix-only cache (moderate effort), 3) staged opt-in rollout (traffic split). Prefix cache estimate: 2 dev days + 1 SRE day.

Rowan: UX note: counts tile is low lift and helps pilots see activity. I can wireframe it today and add copy explaining limits.

Liam: If we do prefix-only cache for MVP, we need a runtime toggle so ops can disable quickly. Suggest flag `runtime.mvp.embcache` with default=false. Add QA steps for toggling without restart.

Anita: Timeline suggestion: scope freeze today EOD, code freeze Tue 09:00, pilot 2026-02-22, GA 2026-03-12. If embcache not ready, ship without it and enable after pilot.

Sanjay: I'll prioritize prefix cache and probes. If we can't finish, we fall back to no-cache and monitor. I'll also add synthetic probes every 10m to catch tail spikes.

ops-bot: Reminder: run `/freeze mvp-trim` before Tue 09:00 to lock merges.

Liam: Action items: Liam -> update cutboard and owners; Anita -> confirm pilot tenants; Rowan -> counts tile + copy; Sanjay -> prefix cache plan + probes; add rollback lane in milestone tracker. Ping this thread when done. :eyes:
